## Checks

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` and `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run test:browser` (if UI changed; screenshot baselines not replaced to hide a regression)
- [ ] `npm run desktop:test` and `cargo fmt --check` (if Rust changed)
- [ ] Regression test added for any bug fix
- [ ] No new network access, telemetry or broad native permissions
